commutator_expansion.interpretation: If the selected up/down alpha_1 responses differ in their heavy-link vector, then H_u and H_d do not commute at leading order.
commutator_expansion.fallback: If Delta v=0, noncommutation may still occur at O(epsilon^2) through light-block and full-response terms; this remains an open fallback calculation.

cp_status.q79_phase: q=79 supplies a CP-active finite character
cp_status.not_enough_by_itself: a CP-active character plus leading noncommutation does not by itself derive CKM angle magnitudes or the Jarlskog invariant
cp_status.full_jarlskog_target: after selected matrices are computed, require nondegenerate spectra and Im det([H_u,H_d]) != 0, equivalently Tr([H_u,H_d]^3) != 0 up to convention

verdict.next_blocker: Compute v_u=(M_u13,M_u23) and v_d=(M_d13,M_d23) from the selected alpha_1 response. If Delta v is nonzero, the up/down Hermitian forms are already noncommuting at leading order.
